seo.title: Thibaut Valez — Product Performance · Delivery · Change Management
seo.description: Independent product consultant. I help CPOs, Heads of Product and leaders ship products that matter — value, execution, team buy-in.

hero.lead: My craft: aligning three levers so a product takes off — value, execution, team buy-in.

approach.claim_a: A strategy that doesn't ship is just a slide.
approach.claim_b: Delivery on the wrong priority is just busywork.
approach.lead: In practice: diagnosis, prioritisation, execution. And a clean handover so teams stay in control when I leave.

audience.qualification: The product is moving too slow. Teams are busy but not shipping. A transformation is stalling. You're looking for someone who goes from diagnosis to execution — not an audit that ends up as a forgotten slide deck.

formats.punch_description: Diagnosis, action plan, momentum back. For unlocking a stuck situation and getting traction quickly.
formats.strategic_description: Building lasting structure for delivery, business impact and value creation. For scaling cleanly without breaking what already works.

missions.m1_description: Built delivery structure and supported the product team from vision to execution.
missions.m2_description: Set up a coherent delivery framework across multiple teams running in parallel.
missions.m3_description: Launched a pilot project from Hong Kong, then operational rollout across five countries on three continents.

ines.name: Inès
ines.tagline: AI product for residential property managers.
ines.description: I'm also building Inès, an AI product that automates document management and customer relations for property syndics. Market of 800,000 condominiums in France. Commercial launch planned for September 2026. It keeps me sharp on founder mode and AI products in real-world conditions.

ai.title: AI transformations, pragmatic.
ai.description: No hype, no doom. Aligning AI use cases with business value and team buy-in. On the ground: the POCs that actually ship, the actual trade-offs, the actual resistance.

final.title: Let's talk about your situation.
final.lead: A 30-minute call to understand where you stand and see if I can help. No strings attached.
